Zahide Hoca is a great researcher and a student can obviously see how professional she is about it. She was kind and respectful, she listened to our concerns and tried to come up with solutions to these problems. 

However although she's a great researcher, she had problems regarding transferring her skills to the lecture and us. It was so hard to understand her sometimes as she has a background from psychology and she tends to give examples from there, making things complex for us. To be able to understand her, I had to study before I came to class and during my studies I realised that her examples and the way she taught the classes were for advanced students and simple examples from everyday life even could be given. In addition to that, it was her responsibility to manage the differences within the students regarding their background and I think although she tried her best, she could still do better with other tactics. Lastly, and connected to my last point, she expected us all to write reports which we never wrote however she didn't lead us through that  and at least the half of us didn't know how to report findings of statistical tests. 

Overall, she tried her best but I expected better from her.

Strongest point is that we are introduced to quantitative data analysis and we used different tools to analyse the data. 

However there are severe weaknesses:

1. We didn't take this course in the labs. Why don't we, when we are supposed to use the statistical softwares to analyse the data? Even the internet was terrible in our classrooms and this created problems while uploading our assignments or downloading data.
